description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableResources class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. It tests immutability, equality/hash code, JSON serialization/deserialization, and creation constraints.

classes.name: ImmutableResourcesTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ImmutableResources class, including immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constraints.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutableResources instances are immutable and contain unmodifiable collections with immutable elements.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableResources correctly implements equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of ImmutableResources objects.

methods.name: createResourcesWithSamePathsShouldFail
methods.description: Ensures that creating resources with duplicate paths throws an IllegalArgumentException.
